TestPreparedStatements::test_dropped_ind.description: Single node: creates table with secondary index on b, prepares 'SELECT * FROM mytable WHERE b=?', executes it, drops the index, executes the prepared statement again. InvalidRequest is caught and printed, any other exception propagates; success is also accepted. No assertion on results or on the error. Port of Cassandra dtest for CASSANDRA-7875 (prepared statements using dropped indexes).

TestPreparedStatements::test_prepared_se.description: Single node, two sessions each prepare 'SELECT * FROM mytable' and verify 10 rows with column b. Then ALTER TABLE ADD c, DROP b; re-executing both prepared statements must return rows with c and without b. Guards CASSANDRA-10786 / JAVA-1196 (stale result metadata for prepared SELECT * after schema change).
